reference: M. A. Eftekhar, Z. Sanjabi-Eznaveh, H. E. Lopez-Aviles, S. Benis, J. E. Antonio-Lopez, M. Kolesik, F. Wise, R. Amezcuas-Correa & D. N. Christodoulides, Accelerated nonlinear interactions in graded-index multimode fibers, Nat. Commun. 10, 1638 (2019), doi:10.1038/s41467-019-09687-9

fiber.note: Methods (PDF p-08): Delta = 1.6e-3, n2 = 2.9e-20 m^2/W, core radius reduced from 40 to 10 um; taper law from Fig. 1 caption region (PDF p-02, a(z) = a0 exp(-gamma z/2)); Fig. 1b example is a 4-cm taper. beta2 = Renninger-Wise fused-silica value at 1550 nm (the paper's fibre is Ge-doped; same order).

pulse.soliton_note: ~N=1 soliton scale for this fibre (E*tau = 2|beta2| c Aeff/(omega0 n2)); the paper's own 400-fs/500-kW pulses are N>>1 inside 55 modes - the fission cascade is out of scope for the 3-mode engine.

simulation.note_on_taper: The engine has no z-dependent dispersion; the taper is propagated in 40 uniform chunks, each rebuilt with the walk-off group_delays, phase_offsets and modal overlaps of its mid-chunk core radius.
